articles.summary: If you’re a Horizons grantee, here’s what you need to know: Horizons Foundation, the world’s first community foundation of, by, and for LGBTQ people, has partnered with Chariot to send grant payments electronically. Since 1980, Horizons has invested in LGBTQ nonprofits, often prioritizing grassroots organizations serving the community’s most under-resourced populations. Now, those grants can reach you faster and more securely than a paper check.
articles.title: Horizons Foundation Now Sends Faster, More Secure Grant Payments Through Chariot
